entities.summary: Alexander Vikentyevich Skvortsov was a Russian ice hockey player who played for the Soviet Union at the Winter Olympics. Skvortsov scored 2 goals during the 1980 games en route to a silver medal, and scored 4 goals in the 1984 games as the Soviets won the gold. He was also a three-time world champion with the Soviet national team.
